title: The Lord's Prayer
reflectionQuestion: Jesus showed us we can talk to God about anything at all. What is something you would most love to thank God for?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Comfort & Bedtime, core-launch finale). COMFORT-RITUAL: the prayer is quoted VERBATIM from WEB Matthew 6:9-13 (incl. the doxology, which WEB carries), NOT a loose retelling -- per registry comfortRitualRule + KID_STORY_PROMPT 2. Structured exactly like 1803 Psalm 23: gentle frame -> verbatim prayer -> soft bedtime close. Per Adam (2026-06-18): keep it like Psalm 23 -- gentle frame + the prayer + soft close, DO NOT over-explain each line ('debts/debtors' left as WEB verbatim, unexplained, the way 1803 left 'valley of the shadow of death'). NO Yahweh -- the Lord's Prayer is an 'Our Father' prayer, not a covenant-name story; 'God'/'Father' throughout. Short-only (comfort-ritual); ~190w is correct, below the 250 floor like Psalm 23 (exempt -- don't pad). VOICE_PRISCILLA_TEACHER (clear, instructive -- teaching a child to pray).
